name: kader-cargo
description: Kader Cargo — plateforme de fret & tracking Chine → Togo (SPA React + API REST)

scripts.setup: node api/scripts/init-env.mjs && npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix api run db:deploy && npm --prefix api run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
